#### HNSWEmbeddingConfig

HNSWEmbeddingConfig contains settings for embedding classification with HNSW indexing

_Appears in:_

- [EmbeddingModelsConfig](#embeddingmodelsconfig)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backend` _string_ | Backend selects the embedding provider backend. |  | Enum: [candle openvino openai_compatible] <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `model_type` _string_ | ModelType specifies which embedding model to use<br />Options: "qwen3" (1024-dim, 32K context), "gemma" (768-dim, 8K context), "mmbert" (64-768-dim, multilingual), "remote" (external provider) |  | Enum: [qwen3 gemma mmbert remote] <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `preload_embeddings` _boolean_ | PreloadEmbeddings enables precomputing candidate embeddings at startup | true | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `target_dimension` _integer_ | TargetDimension is the embedding dimension to use (default: 768)<br />For mmBERT, supported local dimensions are 64, 128, 256, 512, 768.<br />External providers may use other positive dimensions such as 1024, 1536, or 3072. |  | Minimum: 1 <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `target_layer` _integer_ | TargetLayer controls mmBERT early exit and is used only when ModelType is "mmbert".<br />Lower layers reduce encoder work but may reduce quality; layer 22 uses the full encoder depth.<br />Evaluate the latency and quality trade-off on representative deployment data. |  | Enum: [3 6 11 22] <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `enable_soft_matching` _boolean_ | EnableSoftMatching enables soft matching mode | true | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `min_score_threshold` _string_ | MinScoreThreshold for matching (0.0-1.0). Stored as string to avoid float precision issues. | 0.5 | Pattern: `^0(\.[0-9]+)?$\|^1(\.0+)?$` <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |

| `search` _[ValkeyCacheSearch](#valkeycachesearch)_ | Search settings for Valkey queries |  | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `development` _[ValkeyCacheDevelopment](#valkeycachedevelopment)_ | Development settings for Valkey cache |  | Optional: \{\} <br /> |

#### ValkeyCacheConnection

ValkeyCacheConnection defines Valkey connection parameters.

_Appears in:_

- [ValkeyCacheConfig](#valkeycacheconfig)

| Field | Description | Default | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `host` _string_ | Host is the Valkey server hostname or IP address<br />Example: "valkey.default.svc.cluster.local" |  | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `port` _integer_ | Port is the Valkey server port | 6379 | Maximum: 65535 <br />Minimum: 1 <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `database` _integer_ | Database is the Valkey database number to use | 0 | Minimum: 0 <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `password` _string_ | Password for Valkey authentication (plaintext - consider using PasswordSecretRef instead) |  | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `password_secret_ref` _[SecretKeySelector](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api/v1.34/#secretkeyselector-v1-core)_ | PasswordSecretRef references a Secret containing the Valkey password<br />Preferred over plaintext Password field for security |  | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `timeout` _integer_ | Timeout for Valkey operations in seconds | 30 | Minimum: 0 <br />Optional: \{\} <br /> |
| `tls` _[ValkeyCacheTLS](#valkeycachetls)_ | TLS configuration for secure Valkey connections |  | Optional: \{\} <br /> |
